At most one benefit year after delayed care starts; effective use .75/.6/.7; delay .1/.25/.25 years

Priors for wear/fit/breakage within the year after care starts and delayed access, no multiyear extrapolation. Fraction without equivalent alternative correction during the year .7/.7/.6; remaining receive zero credit. Do not reapply referral-completion probability to completed-unit costs.
Public baseline

Coverage/eligibility vary; not all PHC participants have accessible care. Dental changes across official pages have inconsistent dates; no unsupported eligibility-specific treatment effect is inferred.
